blockBottomSpacing.note: Vertical spacing step BELOW the block, as margin-bottom (negative overlaps the next block). One step = --nb-current-spacing (fluid: ~20px @320w, ~32px @1440w at spacing level 1; scales with sm_spacing_level). Applies to the Group's OWN outer margin, and resolves only while it is a direct child of a spacing container (.wp-block-post-content, another Group, a Column, a Sidecar area …).

blockTopSpacing.note: Vertical spacing step ABOVE the block, as margin-top. Prefer this over style.spacing.margin.top — a px margin is frozen; a step is not. One step = --nb-current-spacing (fluid: ~20px @320w, ~32px @1440w at spacing level 1; scales with sm_spacing_level). Applies to the Group's OWN outer margin, and resolves only while it is a direct child of a spacing container (.wp-block-post-content, another Group, a Column, a Sidecar area …).

borderColor.note: No curated vocabulary for this attribute — type and default only. Author a value and prove it with `wp pixelgrade blocks canonicalize` / `validate`.

className.note: No curated vocabulary for this attribute — type and default only. Author a value and prove it with `wp pixelgrade blocks canonicalize` / `validate`.

colorSignal.note: Contextual color intent relative to the parent. Default anchors map signal→variation 0→1, 1→3, 2→8, 3→11. Max is getMaxSignal(palette) (default 3); a block may clamp via supports minColorSignal/maxColorSignal.

contentColorSignal.note: Color signal of the block's content area (hosts with contentColorSignal support, e.g. Supernova).

contentPaletteVariation.note: Resolved grade of the content area; keep consistent with contentColorSignal.

emphasisArea.note: Percentage of block width covered by the colored background. Only meaningful on horizontal Supernova cards (cardLayout horizontal / horizontal-reverse).

emphasisBottomSpacing.note: INNER bottom spacing, as padding-bottom — the band inset. Half steps are allowed. One step = --nb-current-spacing (fluid: ~20px @320w, ~32px @1440w at spacing level 1; scales with sm_spacing_level). Applies inside the Group. On a Group carrying a Color Signal the inset is floored at 0.75 of the wrapper side spacing, so a small step can be swallowed by that floor.

emphasisTopSpacing.note: INNER top spacing, as padding-top — the band inset. Prefer this over style.spacing.padding.top. Half steps are allowed, so a 128-200px band is authored directly (5.5 ≈ 176px at 1440w, spacing level 1). Min is 0 here: negative inner spacing needs supports.novaBlocks.spaceAndSizing.advancedSpacing, which the core containers do not declare. One step = --nb-current-spacing (fluid: ~20px @320w, ~32px @1440w at spacing level 1; scales with sm_spacing_level). Applies inside the Group. On a Group carrying a Color Signal the inset is floored at 0.75 of the wrapper side spacing, so a small step can be swallowed by that floor.

spacingModifier.note: Scales the spacing of the elements INSIDE this container (not the container itself). 0 zeroes every descendant spacing control.

Reach for it only for the OUTER steps (blockTop/BottomSpacing, capped at 3) or past 6 inner steps — the band inset itself now goes to 6 in half steps without it, and unlike this multiplier a plain step is not inherited by descendants.
